title: CVE-2022-26138: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
summary: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.

title: CVE-2022-22047: Microsoft Windows Client Server Runtime Subsystem (CSRSS) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows CSRSS contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation to SYSTEM privileges.

title: CVE-2022-26925: Microsoft Windows LSA Spoofing Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Local Security Authority (LSA) contains a spoofing vulnerability where an attacker can coerce the domain controller to authenticate to the attacker using NTLM.
